description: Task Analysis — Hand a task, get a structured plan back — typed steps, risks, and a go/caution/no-go verdict. Runs claude-haiku-4.5 — the response names the model that served the call. Input: {task: string}. Returns {analysis: {summary, steps, risks, verdict}, model}. (5 MESH/call, a tool · reasoning)

task.description: REQUIRED — the task to break down into a structured plan. Coerced to string, trimmed, truncated to 4000 chars (not rejected). Whitespace-only rejected after trim. Fallback keys text or input accepted; task is canonical.
